text.description_html:
Omnia 24895F00R15, Rope Pattern Mortise Lockset

The Rope Pattern with Wave Lever Mortise Lockset features elegant rope detailing that is a timeless classic in home decor. This is a special ordered right hand panic proof entry leverset in satin nickel with a 2.5" backset for a 1-3/4" thick door.

Features of the Classic Rope Lockset:

  • Keyway: Schlage "C"
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • UL Listed 3 Hour
  • ANSI A156.13.2005, Grade 1 Lock

Specifications for Omnia 24895F00R15 Rope Mortise Entryset:

  • Material: Brass
  • Backplate Height: 10-5/8"
  • Backplate Width: 2-3/8"
  • Lever Length: 4-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-1⁄2”
  • Minimum Stile: 3-7⁄8”
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass faceplate.
  • Strike: Solid brass curved lip strike.4-7⁄8” x 1-1⁄4” x lip 1-1⁄4” to center.
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Omnia Mortise Lockset Dimensions and Specifications (PDF)

Function:

  • Panic Proof Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
